passages.description: Synthetic 4-measure Debussy-like passage mimicking Arabesque No.1 mm.34-37: repeated ascending RH pattern (mm34-35), two-voice texture inside pattern, closing broad arpeggiated arrival (mm36-37), LH octave relocation into arpeggio.

hand_labeled_events.note: ascending repeated RH patterned figure across two measures
two-voice RH texture inside that pattern — overlaps repeated pattern
left-hand octave relocation into the arpeggio
